title: T187 PNC - Hashem Pays Measure for Measure — a Great Kindness
hebrewTitle: הקב"ה מודד מידה כנגד מידה — חסד גדול
author: Petten Nanach

beginner.en: "And to You Hashem is the kindness, for You pay a man according to his deed" (Psalms 62). Rebbe Nachman sees a great kindness hidden in this: the fact that Hashem repays us measure for measure is itself merciful. It means our deeds actually matter — they shape our destiny. If outcomes were random, nothing we did would count. But because Hashem tracks everything precisely and responds in kind, we can trust that effort, prayer, and good deeds genuinely change our lives.

intermediate.en: T187: "And to You Hashem is the kindness, for You pay a man according to his deed" (Psalms 62:13). The measure-for-measure (midah k'neged midah) principle itself is a supreme kindness — it guarantees that our actions have real weight and consequence. LM 187.
intermediate.he: מידה כנגד מידה היא עצמה חסד עצום — שמעשינו קובעים גורלנו. אלמלא כן, תפילה ומצוות לא ישפיעו.

scholarly.he: LM א׳ קפ״ז — "ולך ה׳ חסד כי אתה תשלם לאיש כמעשהו" (תהלים סב:יג); עיקר החסד הוא שמידה כנגד מידה.
